label: Seedance 2.5 multimodal video with large-scale reference control

prompt_contract.style: prose sentences in formula order, extended by a beat timeline for long clips
notes: The template reads: subject does main action in setting, the image is visual style, the camera uses shot size position movement or cut, sound includes dialogue ambience effects or music.
Long clips written as one continuous sentence drift in character and camera; give them beats.
Every reference needs an assignment sentence stating what it supplies and what it must not control.

camera_control.command_syntax: name shot size, camera position, movement, or cut inside the camera sentence, or inside the beat that carries it
notes: One camera move per clip or per beat; a second move in the same beat competes with the first.

multi_shot_control.syntax: a beat per line, each naming its seconds, what is on screen, what the camera does, and its audio, for example 0-3s followed by the beat description

shot_budget.shots: a full beat sheet, audio attached to each beat

notes: Audio cues belong inside their beat rather than gathered at the end of the prompt.

sweet_spots: up to 8s a single described shot
edit operations require the auto duration

audio_control.sound_syntax: the notation separates the kinds: parentheses for music, angle brackets for sound effects, braces for dialogue, and lenticular brackets for subtitles
audio_control.dialogue_syntax: state the language variant and the delivery, then the line in braces
audio_control.unspecified_behaviour: audio is generated in the same pass, so silence must be requested by name
notes: Audio and video are produced together, which supports lip sync with subtitles.
Subtitles are the most reliable on-screen text; keep the words common and avoid special symbols.

frame_control.resolution_parameter: resolution preset, mutually exclusive with width and height
notes: Frame images and source video both forbid explicit width and height.
Every pair above, including the 1080p tier, is in the host's parameter schema for this model.

input_modes.text_must_establish: world, character appearance, placement, state, camera, action, and landing

input_modes.limits: at most two, addressed as first and last
input_modes.text_must_establish: the path between them without creating a competing landing

input_modes.limits: up to thirty by the surface; guidance recommends at most eight subjects, stretching to twelve, before features dilute
input_modes.media_supplies: identity, wardrobe, palette, or a defined side of one object, according to the assigned role
input_modes.text_must_establish: each reference's job by citation, and what it must not control

input_modes.limits: up to ten, each 2 to 30 seconds; guidance recommends at most five subjects
input_modes.media_supplies: motion, timing, camera, or an accepted anchor shot treated as ground truth for continuity
input_modes.text_must_establish: what carries over and what changes

input_modes.limits: one clip, 2 to 30 seconds; edit requires the auto duration
input_modes.media_supplies: the existing clip to modify or continue
input_modes.text_must_establish: which change is wanted, or how the continuation proceeds from the ending

input_modes.limits: up to ten, each 2 to 30 seconds
input_modes.text_must_establish: who speaks and how the audio relates to the visible action

anti_patterns: a reference cited without a stated job, which lets its background and lighting bleed in
more references than the guidance recommends, which dilutes the features that matter
a long clip written as one sentence rather than a beat timeline
reference clips shorter than two seconds, which carry too little information
mixing prompt languages when on-screen text is wanted
special symbols in text that must render on screen
leaving silence unstated when a beat should be quiet

duration_seconds.auto: accepted in place of a number, and required when settings.operation is edit

constraints.geometry: width and height together, from the listed pairs, or the resolution preset (480p, 720p, 1080p); both are refused with frame images or a source video, and the preset is exclusive with width and height
constraints.text: positivePrompt of 2 to 10000 characters, required when the request carries no input

frame_images.placement: at least one of them is not the last frame

reference_videos.input: an uploaded media id or a URL, not a data URI

reference_audios.input: an uploaded media id or a URL

source_video.operation: edit or extend under settings.operation; omitted, the prompt decides

constraints.frame_images_exclusive_with: reference images, reference videos and a source video
constraints.seed: not in the schema: the service exposes no seed for this model
constraints.inputs_envelope: media keys sit inside an inputs object (inputs.referenceImages, inputs.frameImages, inputs.referenceVideos, inputs.referenceAudios, inputs.video)
